purpose: Controlled capture and diagnostic transfer measurements, not automatic hardware-fidelity acceptance

conditions.sampler: Both engines clock at chip rate, then the same integer phase chooses exact completed sample ticks
conditions.initialization: All voices TEST/TRI/Gate-off until ENV3=0 and OSC3=0; active voice3 TEST/Gate to target sustain; no private state injection
conditions.gain: No PCM phase/gain/DC correction; transfer is each engine filtered harmonic amplitude divided by its own dry capture
conditions.samplePhase: Retained through skip; exact chip ticks reconstructed from global sample indices
conditions.externalRc: Unchanged; dry/filtered ratios reduce its contribution. RC/loading and nonlinear differences remain diagnostic.

dataset: held-out FC256 RES2/6/10/14 at two levels; denser FC128 RES15 check
